name: nl.svv-schatzoekers/public-selling-agent
title: SVV-Schatzoekers Public Selling Agent
description: Read-only product discovery, merchant trust, shipping and returns for SVV-Schatzoekers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find the public merchant documents available through fetch.

query.description: Words to match against public shipping, returns or reputation documents. An empty query lists both documents.

tools.name: agent_query
tools.description: Ask SVV a bounded public question. Supported intents: capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust and product_search. This tool never orders, negotiates, contacts people, takes payment or changes store data.

intent.description: Select capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust or product_search.

query.description: For product_search, enter at least two characters of a product name, character, brand or franchise. The first 200 characters are used.

max_results.description: Maximum number of product matches to return, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

max_price_eur.description: Optional inclusive upper limit in euros for a product’s minimum catalog price.

in_stock_only.description: For product_search, include only items with positive catalog stock when true. Defaults to true.

permission_scope.description: Use public_read, the supported permission scope for these queries.

request_id.description: Optional client reference echoed in the response, up to 128 characters.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read public reputation or shipping and returns information for SVV-Schatzoekers.

id.description: Public merchant document ID returned by search: merchant_trust_bundle or merchant_policy_bundle.
